revalidation: The checked reference body and trial inputs match prior reviewed bytes. Only separately packaged atlas, design routing and playtest links were appended.
baseline: Two labeled forks and one-press route choice without a purchased clue.
candidate: Spend one reserve token to reveal an accessible fact before the route choice or carry the token.

cases.confirmed: Stationary landing after lookout supports an accessible persistent text cue and is eligible for strict comparison.
cases.false: Exact landing lacks the required cue. Decline the combination, retain the baseline and reconsider when direct cue support is verified.
cases.unknown: Conditional fit only. Inspect cue persistence with a paper board and one-press choice.

unsuitable: The narrow crossing precedes the lookout and prevents stopping.
proposed_check: Compare a fixed paper route approach with and without one accessible cue and removable token. Record fact use, deliberate token saving, one-press action and cue persistence.
rejection: Cue, author condition, access or meaningful choice fails. Reconsider on a verified change to the affected condition.
handoff: Route rules owner receives both exact rule references.
Landing owner receives the exact placement context and cue and input check.
cost: One paper cue and test observation. Spending consumes the option to use the token at the next marker.
limitation: Independent document and paper-state inspection. Participant observations remain planned.
